title: PMOS Companion — Complete Features Specification
summary: Feasibility-corrected feature catalogue for a phone-only PMOS/PCOS monitoring app, with §0 platform-policy and evidence rulings cutting ten features.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC applied as authoritative; content agrees (capture pipelines, DSP chains, platform API constraints, compliance checklist). Section 0 rulings are constraints, not features: ten features cut on App Store 1.4.1 (camera SpO2, PTT BP), platform blocking of passive/background camera capture on iOS/Android/PWA, CGM cost and absent legal third-party API in India, and construct-validity failure of facial-expression stress inference; plus BCG hardware dependency, cross-lingual voice mood collapse, no validated automated mFG scorer, keystroke-dynamics API absence, and Google Fit API retirement. Also constraint-bearing: native required (PWA cannot deliver sensing core), zero features may depend on wearables or lab values, 25-45% camera capture failure expected for MST 5-8, HRV personal z-score only, no single precise digit displayed, PHRM model/dataset licence-blocked.
